about_short_description.short_description: Mezmo is an observability platform to manage and take action on your data.

product.name: AURA
product.description: An open-source agentic harness for defining, running, integrating, and governing production AI workflows, including SRE investigations and operational automation.

product.name: Active Telemetry
product.description: A telemetry data management capability that routes, transforms, filters, enriches, and analyzes logs, metrics, and traces before they reach observability platforms.

product.name: Mezmo Telemetry Pipelines
product.description: A pipeline platform for collecting, processing, and routing observability data across sources and destinations, with controls for data quality, cost, compliance, and operational response.

product.name: Mezmo AI SRE
product.description: An AI-assisted site reliability engineering capability that uses telemetry and agentic workflows to investigate incidents, perform root cause analysis, and support operational response.
